title: ellipsis needs more input
name: Ellipsis means more input — NN/g
rule: Append an ellipsis when the command needs more information or opens another window, view, or app.

citation.source: NN/g — UI Copy; Apple HIG — Buttons

pass_when: Ellipsis is present when more input is required or another window/view/app opens; absent when the action completes immediately.
fail_when: Ellipsis on an immediate-complete command, or no ellipsis when more input / another view is required.
overview: An ellipsis marks commands that need more input or open another view.
apply_when: Command opens a dialog, another view, or needs further information.
not_when: Actions that complete immediately with no further input or window.
agent_hint: Add ellipsis only when more input or another window is required.
description: Append an ellipsis when a command needs more information or opens another window, view, or app. Omit it when the action completes immediately with no further input. Ellipsis on an instant command, or missing ellipsis when more input is required, mis-sets expectations about what happens next. Match the mark to whether the person still has work to do after the click.
